attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: game_and_schedule_management
steps:
  - id: receive_game_form
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/games/scheduling-form"
    output: raw_game_form

  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "admin"
    output: admin_auth

  - id: validate_game_form
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_game_form
      schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - home_team
          - away_team
          - league
          - date
          - time
          - venue
        properties:
          home_team:
            type: string
          away_team:
            type: string
          league:
            type: string
          date:
            type: string
            format: date
          time:
            type: string
          venue:
            type: string
    output: validated_game_form

  - id: extract_league
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      field: "league"
    output: league_id

  - id: fetch_league_teams
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: teams
      conditions:
        league: league_id
    output: raw_league_teams

  - id: validate_league_teams
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_league_teams
      schema:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          required:
            - team_id
            - league
    output: validated_league_teams

  - id: filter_home_team_in_league
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_league_teams
      condition: "team_id == validated_game_form.home_team"
    output: home_team_match

  - id: filter_away_team_in_league
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_league_teams
      condition: "team_id == validated_game_form.away_team"
    output: away_team_match

  - id: apply_league_membership_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "home_team_match is not empty AND away_team_match is not empty"
      on_fail: "terminate_invalid_teams"
    output: league_check_result

  - id: handle_invalid_teams
    op: handle_error
    params:
      error_source: apply_league_membership_rule
      route_to: terminate_invalid_teams

  - id: fetch_existing_games
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: games
      conditions:
        date: validated_game_form.date
    output: raw_existing_games

  - id: validate_existing_games
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_existing_games
      schema:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            home_team:
              type: string
            away_team:
              type: string
            date:
              type: string
    output: validated_existing_games

  - id: filter_conflict_home
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_existing_games
      condition: "home_team == validated_game_form.home_team OR away_team == validated_game_form.home_team"
    output: home_conflicts

  - id: filter_conflict_away
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_existing_games
      condition: "home_team == validated_game_form.away_team OR away_team == validated_game_form.away_team"
    output: away_conflicts

  - id: apply_conflict_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "home_conflicts is empty AND away_conflicts is empty"
      on_fail: "terminate_scheduling_conflict"
    output: conflict_check_result

  - id: handle_conflict_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      error_source: apply_conflict_rule
      route_to: terminate_scheduling_conflict

  - id: prepare_game_record
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      mapping:
        home_team: "home_team"
        away_team: "away_team"
        league: "league"
        date: "date"
        time: "time"
        venue: "venue"
        status: "scheduled"
    output: game_record

  - id: insert_game_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: game_record
      table: games
    output: write_result

  - id: log_game_scheduled
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: game_record
      message: "Game scheduled successfully"
    output: audit_log_result

  - id: notify_admin_success
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: game_record
      recipient: "admin"
      message: "Game has been successfully scheduled."
    output: notification_result

  - id: terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "success"

  - id: terminate_invalid_teams
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failed"
      reason: "One or both teams do not belong to the specified league."

  - id: terminate_scheduling_conflict
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failed"
      reason: "Scheduling conflict detected. A team already has a game on the specified date."
